title: Compact Hyperbolic Coxeter Six-dimensional Polytopes With Ten Facets
summary: We show that, up to isometry, there is exactly one compact hyperbolic Coxeter 6-polytope with 10 facets, the polytope $P_{6,10}$ attributed to Bugaenko. Together with results of Felikson-Tumarkin ($d \ge 7$) and of Burcroff and Ma-Zheng ($d = 4, 5$), this completes the classification of compact hyperbolic Coxeter $d$-polytopes with $d+4$ facets. The proof is computer assisted. Affine Gale duality applied to the complete database of order types on 10 points yields 387 combinatorial types, of which Lannér's classification excludes 83.
